scope: LeRobot v3 storage timeline; physical sensor/action synchronization is not assessed

decoder.selection_rule: seek backward then nearest PTS in a bounded forward window

limitations: Fragmented MP4, trimming/multiple edits and large composition tables are unsupported
Official LeRobot decoder verification requires the separate verify command
mdhd versus stts duration equality is assessed only on tracks without composition offsets
Ordinal alignment assumes full ordered episode metadata within each video shard

sample_source.note: Real Stretch mobile-manipulator episodes, 135 episodes at 5 FPS, single camera, chunked video layout. Adds a wheeled mobile platform and a low frame rate to the audited sources.
